snippet.title: Yooka-Replaylee | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Who knew the world needed two treasure hunters to save it? Yooka-Replaylee is out RIGHT NOW!

BUY IT NOW ON ⤵️
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448020/YookaReplaylee/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10012610
Xbox: https://xbox.com/en-US/games/store/yooka-replaylee/9p5w99stchm7
Nintendo: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Yooka-Replaylee-2925507.html

The open-world 3D platforming epic and a reimagining of the beloved Yooka-Laylee. In this retelling of their biggest adventure to date, Yooka and Laylee share the story about how they took on the corporate creep Capital B, who attempted to change the course of the universe by stealing the One Book, with a few embellishments sprinkled in for good measure. 

Step into a wacky adventure across many fantastical and imaginative worlds, full of colourful characters and vault-loads of shiny collectables, and save the world!
